source: Dummy curation review packet seed mirrored from manual-work-queue.md. Packets remain blockers until Dawson provides reviewed inputs or removes the linked gate from launch scope.
notes: This seed is intentionally metadata-only: no user measurements, account data, photos, lab values, credentials, private notes, or reviewer identities.
Each packet points to the existing editable seed/template files and the evidence needed before replacing dummy content with production content.

packets.label: Strategy corpus source review
inputRequired: Prioritized outcome list for the first public corpus
Source-reviewed strategy entries with evidence, risk, reversibility, legal notes, and contraindications
High-risk moderation decisions and non-personalization labels
reviewerQuestions: Which 2-3 outcomes should ship in v1?
Which high-risk categories are informational-only, web-only, or excluded?
What source standard is required for public entries versus n=1 case logs?
acceptanceCriteria: Every public strategy has source metadata, evidence/risk/reversibility scores, legal notes, uncertainty notes, and reviewed high-risk status.
No imported or user-submitted case log publishes automatically.
High-risk strategies remain excluded from personalization.
currentScaffold: Backend strategy corpus seed and import/export template
Strategy explorer age gate, high-risk acknowledgment, and linked case-log rendering

packets.label: Production target profile curation
inputRequired: Target library scope
Source or estimation method for each target
Production notes and uncertainty labels
Decision on named fictional or real-person targets
reviewerQuestions: Which target archetypes are acceptable for v1?
Can any named target be used, or should all profiles remain generic archetypes?
What uncertainty language is required per source type?
acceptanceCriteria: Every target validates against the shared measurement schema.
Every target has source type, notes, and uncertainty framing.
Named-person policy is explicitly approved or targets remain archetypal.

packets.label: Broader reference data curation
inputRequired: Selected reference population for fields not covered by NHANES
Source URL, license, codebook confirmation, field mapping, and unit conversion rules
Production reference label and fixture outputs for tests
reviewerQuestions: Should unsupported fields use ANSUR, another source, or remain visibly scaffolded?
What label should the population panel show for each source?
Which fields need sex-specific empirical tables before launch?
acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported fields are replaced with reviewed data or clearly remain scaffold-labeled.
License/source notes are documented before any production overlay is used.
Population panel labels match the reviewed source metadata.
currentScaffold: NHANES adult height, weight, waist, and hip overlay

packets.label: FoodData Central production review
inputRequired: API-key storage and server-side fetch policy
Source/citation wording and refresh cadence
Approved serving-size policy for per-100 g values versus serving-size scaling
Production nutrition QA fixtures for generic, branded, and edge-case rows
reviewerQuestions: Should branded foods come from FDC, Open Food Facts, or both?
What refresh cadence is acceptable for production nutrition data?
Which edge-case nutrient rows should block seed promotion?
acceptanceCriteria: Candidate rows use real numeric FDC IDs unless explicitly kept as dummy seed rows.
Macro and micronutrient keys are present and nonnegative.
Serving-size conversion policy is documented before replacing the dummy seed.
currentScaffold: Diet search merges backend foods with Open Food Facts

packets.label: Attractiveness evidence review
inputRequired: Approve or revise attractiveness-evidence-base.md
Decide which evidence rows can ship as reference-only goal context
Review summaries for non-prescriptive wording and contested-claim labels
reviewerQuestions: Which rows are shippable as reference context?
Which contested claims should be hidden, kept as needs-research, or removed?
Is additional source review required for height, FFMI, body symmetry, or facial-ratio claims?
acceptanceCriteria: Every row has a reviewed verdict: ship-reference, needs-research, or do-not-ship.
Goal UI copy stays reference-only and non-prescriptive.
Contested face/body claims are not converted into target recommendations.
currentScaffold: Backend attractiveness evidence seed and API
Goal builder evidence notes with review status

packets.label: Procedure taxonomy review
inputRequired: Reviewed procedure categories and labels
Default healing-window ranges by procedure/body area
Affected measurement field mappings
Approved photo stream guidance and safety copy
reviewerQuestions: Which procedure categories belong in the initial local-only tracker?
Which affected fields should pause trend/goal interpretation?
What safety wording is required for body-mod and clinical-adjacent logs?
acceptanceCriteria: Each procedure type has reviewed category, affected fields, healing window, risk level, and photo category.
Procedure logs remain local-first and informational.
Reliability windows pause affected trend and goal interpretation.
currentScaffold: Procedure reliability events and progress-report case logs

packets.label: Bloodwork marker and range review
inputRequired: Reviewed marker groups, labels, units, and aliases
Sex/context-specific reference ranges and out-of-range copy
Approved panel presets for hormones, lipids, metabolic, thyroid, and inflammation markers
Explicit local-only health-data privacy copy
reviewerQuestions: Which marker panels are acceptable for the local-only prototype?
Which reference ranges need sex, age, or context-specific review before public copy?
Should any future sync of lab metadata remain client-side encrypted only?
acceptanceCriteria: Each marker has reviewed units, group, summary, aliases where needed, and reference ranges.
Out-of-range copy remains informational and not diagnostic.
Bloodwork stays excluded from public share dashboards and plaintext server sync.
currentScaffold: Backend bloodwork marker seed and API
Local-only lab-result entry and trend rows
Export, encrypted backup, and progress-report inclusion
